game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row, a street of busy forges: the baker's apprentice must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the drawbridge reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row: a street of busy forges
core_gameplay_loop: In Blacksmith Row, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the drawbridge reads the right value at run time. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the y value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the drawbridge using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the drawbridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Blacksmith Row'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Blacksmith Row.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The drawbridge reached with actions_used <= 20.
